Server role: ROLE_STANDALONE

# Global parameters
[global]
	disable netbios = Yes
	disable spoolss = Yes
	load printers = No
	log file = /var/log/samba/log.%m
	max log size = 0
	netbios name = CAPTURE
	printcap name = /dev/null
	server min protocol = SMB3
	server role = standalone server
	server smb transports = 445
	idmap config * : backend = tdb
	force group = myUser
	force user = myUser
	path = /srv/names/9
	printing = bsd
	valid users = writer


[My Share]
	path = /srv/names/0


[Fotos ä]
	path = /srv/names/1


[semi;colon]
	path = /srv/names/2


[it's]
	path = /srv/names/3


[dollar$]
	path = /srv/names/4


[x=y]
	path = /srv/names/5


[a/b]
	path = /srv/names/6


[a\b]
	path = /srv/names/7


[#hash]
	path = /srv/names/8


[Homes]
	path = /srv/names/10


[IPC$]
	path = /srv/names/11


[nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn]
